item.title: Sutter Health Welcomes Hayashida Physical Therapy
item.description: SANTA BARBARA, Calif — Sutter Health leaders, physicians and physical therapists officially welcomed Hayashida Physical Therapy into the Sutter network on February 19, marking a significant milestone in expanding access to integrated, patient-centered orthopedic and sports medicine care along the Central Coast.
